description: NVIDIA dcgm-exporter: utilization, memory, thermals, power, throttling, XID and ECC health, plus per-workload GPU usage via the Kubernetes pod mapping.

panels.title: GPUs
panels.description: GPUs matching the filters.

targets.expr: count(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Avg GPU utilization
panels.description: Average DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL across the selection.

targets.expr: avg(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Framebuffer used
panels.description: GPU memory in use across the selection.

targets.expr: sum(DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) / (sum(DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) + sum(DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}))

panels.title: Power draw
panels.description: Total power draw.

targets.expr: sum(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Max GPU temperature
panels.description: Hottest GPU.

targets.expr: max(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: GPUs with XID error
panels.description: GPUs whose last XID error is non-zero. See the Errors row and NVIDIA's XID catalog.

targets.expr: count(DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} != 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPU utilization
panels.description: Fraction of time a kernel was running (coarse; 100% does not mean the SMs are saturated).

targets.expr: avg by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Graphics engine and tensor activity
panels.description: DCP profiling metrics (datacenter GPUs only). Tensor pipe activity is the best signal of real matmul load for LLM inference.

targets.expr: avg by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
avg by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Memory bandwidth activity
panels.description: Device memory interface activity. LLM decode is usually memory-bandwidth bound.

targets.expr: avg by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
avg by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_COPY_UTIL{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) / 100

panels.title: PCIe and NVLink throughput
panels.description: PCIe (DCP metric, bytes/s) and NVLink aggregate bandwidth (reported in MB/s, converted to bytes/s).

targets.expr: sum by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_TX_BYTES{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
sum by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_RX_BYTES{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
sum by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_BANDWIDTH_TOTAL{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) * 1e6

panels.title: Framebuffer used
panels.description: GPU memory used per GPU (reported in MiB). vLLM/SGLang pre-allocate most memory for KV cache, so high usage is expected.

targets.expr: sum by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) * 1048576

panels.title: Framebuffer used ratio
panels.description: Used / (used + free) per GPU.

targets.expr: sum by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) / (sum by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) + sum by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}))

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: GPU core and HBM temperature.

targets.expr: max by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
max by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Power draw
panels.description: Power draw per GPU.

targets.expr: sum by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: SM clock
panels.description: SM clock. A drop under load with high temperature or power means throttling.

targets.expr: max by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) * 1e6

panels.title: Time throttled
panels.description: Fraction of time clocks were limited by power or thermal constraints. These counters are commented out in the default dcgm-exporter CSV: enable DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION and DCGM_FI_DEV_THERMAL_VIOLATION to populate this panel.

targets.expr: sum by (Hostname, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9
sum by (Hostname, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_THERMAL_VIOLATION{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9

panels.title: Last XID error per GPU
panels.description: GPUs reporting a non-zero XID. 48 = double-bit ECC, 63/64 = row remapping, 79 = GPU fell off the bus, 94/95 = contained/uncontained ECC, 13/31/43 = usually application faults. Empty table = healthy.

targets.expr: max by (Hostname, gpu, modelName, UUID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) != 0

panels.title: PCIe replays
panels.description: PCIe link retries per second. Sustained values point to a bad riser, slot or cable.

targets.expr: sum by (Hostname, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_PCIE_REPLAY_COUNTER{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Remapped rows
panels.description: HBM row remapping (A100/H100). Any remap failure or growing uncorrectable count means the GPU needs a reset or RMA.

targets.expr: max by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
max by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_CORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
max by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_ROW_REMAP_FAILURE{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: GPU utilization by pod
panels.description: Average utilization of the GPUs assigned to each pod (requires the dcgm-exporter Kubernetes pod mapping).

targets.expr: avg by (namespace, pod) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", pod!=""})

panels.title: GPU memory by pod
panels.description: Framebuffer used by the GPUs assigned to each pod.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"$Hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", pod!=""}) * 1048576

title: NVIDIA GPU (DCGM exporter)
